modelInputAllowlist.description: The only Evidence Packet fields that may be projected into a language request. Anything absent from this list is dropped, including fields added to the Workbench contract later.
modelInputAllowlist.deniedFieldsReason: Evidence items carry source record keys and raw values, including RM note excerpts. The model is given claims and their citation identifiers, never the underlying records.
